name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages Nginx for three SSL-enabled sites, including static document roots, security headers, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and development self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, logging, listener settings, and removal of replication-related configuration directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI tutorial application with Python tooling, PostgreSQL packages and database setup, source checkout, virtual environment, dependencies, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
